report_md:
## NOO-17 vacancy research — 267 4th St, Oakland

**Parcel:** APN 001-0153-014-00 (issue notation: 001 015301400)
**Research date:** 2026-10-15
**Verdict:** unknown (confidence 0.2)
**Vacancy start / duration:** unknown; no dated vacancy evidence found.

### Evidence reviewed

- The [National Register nomination](https://localwiki.org/oakland/waterfront%20warehouse%20district/_files/00000361.pdf) identifies 267 4th Street as APN 001-0153-014 and describes a historic warehouse converted into two floors of offices. This source is historical and cannot establish present occupancy.
- [LoopNet's property record](https://www.loopnet.com/property/267-4th-st-oakland-ca-94607/06001-001%20015301400/) matches the full APN and lists an office building of 14,140 square feet with 2024 tax-year and 2025 assessment data. The property classification is not a current occupancy observation.
- The City of Oakland's [October 2022 closed business accounts list](https://cao-94612.s3.amazonaws.com/documents/Closed-Business-Accounts-October-2022.pdf) lists Huntleigh Coronado Properties LLC at this address as a nonresidential building lessor, with an account expiration date of 2021-12-31. The account closure may reflect a business/tax registration change and does not establish vacancy or a tenant departure date.

Searches for current address-specific listings, permits, code/blight records, utility status, street-view dates, news, and vacancy-tax records did not produce a reliable, dated observation of occupancy or vacancy. A rental post surfaced at the same map address but described a 1,213-square-foot condo and conflicts with the parcel's 14,140-square-foot office-building record, so it was excluded as a likely address/parcel mismatch.

**Conclusion:** Public evidence supports historical office use and a landlord registration that ended in 2021, but does not resolve whether the property is vacant now. Do not infer a vacancy start or duration from the landlord account expiration.
